descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S05 Hospital server search: edits while searching, sparse pages, another physician's patient

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 4; TFA-92581 AC 5)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Owner with four prefixed patients plus two unrelated rows; a second physician with an exact-match patient

When Page through rounding:listPage two rows at a time by room, name and status; search by name, MRN, diagnosis and room; then rename the patient, move its room and change its status; then remove it

Then Orders correct on every sort; empty scanned pages are followed instead of read as 'no match'; edits re-filter and re-sort at once; the other physician's match is never returned

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright API assertions on returned ids (U1, U2). The snf variant of this test is not used: it also asserts that a Nursing Home diagnosis search returns the resident, which AC 3 forbids; S06 replaces it. Needs precondition P1: without it the test fails with 'Run migrations:backfillPatientLists…' and is reported broken (env), not Fail

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (paging and edit legs) / local (other-physician leg); Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-03 Search & Sort · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-03/S05

Hospital server search: edits while searching, sparse pages, another physician's patient

Tickets: TFA-92581 Search & Sort (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-03.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/patient-list.spec.ts [api] — hospital: server search, indexed order, sparse pagination, isolation and projection updates — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/patient-list.spec.ts): it signs in two local test physicians (demo and other) through e2e/support/backend.ts, the local stack's test sign-in and admin helpers; on dev nothing may sign in, there is one shared account and no admin key, so it runs on the local stack on…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
